summary: Frontend-only visual audit of the new 'Tactile OS — Soft Neumorphic Monochrome' LIGHT theme for the teacher area (html.mode-light.in-app), plus dark-mode regression + student page isolation check. Logged in as admin/teacher123, forced localStorage.al_khairat_mode='light' and reloaded, then audited every page listed in the review: /teacher/dashboard, /teacher/question-bank (with grade-tab switching), /teacher/gradebooks (+ card render), /teacher/rubrics, /teacher/settings (mode/font/year cards), and /teacher/quiz/{id}/edit (opened via dashboard 'تعديل' button). Ran a DOM sweep on each page checking every button/badge/chip/tab/btn element for saturated (non-monochrome) background colors and for text/background contrast collisions. RESULT: dashboard, question-bank, gradebooks, rubrics, settings all render fully monochrome (bodyBg rgb(236,236,236), cards near-white, active nav pill solid black with white text, primary CTAs black — 0 saturated offenders on each page). Dark mode confirmed untouched (htmlClass has no 'mode-light', bodyBg rgb(5,5,5), colored accents (green/red/purple) present as expected). Student join page at '/' correctly does NOT receive light-mode overrides — htmlClass is 'theme-soft theme-lux' with no 'mode-light' and no 'in-app', bodyBg stays rgb(11,17,32), so Kahoot answer colors remain intact. Functional smoke tests OK: nav pill click navigates, grade tab click in question bank works, question-bank filters render, settings toggles clickable. ONE PAGE STILL LEAKS COLOR — the quiz editor (/teacher/quiz/{id}/edit) has two hard-coded Tailwind colored buttons that the .mode-light.in-app CSS overrides do not catch: bright yellow 'مراقبة الاختبار' (bg-yellow-400 rgb(250,204,21)) in the editor header and teal 'نسخ' (bg-teal-600 rgb(13,148,136)) copy button next to the quiz code. Both stand out against the monochrome Tactile OS surface. See screenshot /app/.screenshots/light/quiz-editor.png.

ui_bugs.issue: 'مراقبة الاختبار' button renders bright yellow (bg-yellow-400 rgb(250,204,21)) in light mode — breaks Tactile OS monochrome palette. Same button appears in the dashboard 'مراقبة' row too and is already handled there via .mode-light.in-app rule, but the quiz editor variant uses a different class combination that isn't covered.
'نسخ' copy button renders teal (bg-teal-600 rgb(13,148,136)) in light mode — colored accent violates monochrome brief.

issues: Two Tailwind hard-coded color buttons (bg-yellow-400 'مراقبة الاختبار' and bg-teal-600 'نسخ') leak color into the otherwise monochrome Tactile OS surface. Add scoped overrides under html.mode-light.in-app for .bg-yellow-400 and .bg-teal-600 within the quiz editor, or replace with the neutral .btn-primary/.btn-ghost tokens.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/index.css (TACTILE OS section) or the QuizEditor.jsx component, override the two remaining colored buttons on /teacher/quiz/{id}/edit so they become monochrome in html.mode-light.in-app: (a) 'مراقبة الاختبار' bg-yellow-400 button, (b) 'نسخ' bg-teal-600 secret-code copy button. Keep them colored in dark mode (default).
critical_code_review_comments: The current strategy of scoping monochrome overrides via html.mode-light.in-app is fragile: any component that uses page-specific Tailwind color utilities (bg-yellow-400, bg-teal-600, bg-emerald-*, etc.) without a matching override rule will leak color into light mode. Consider one of: (1) a Tailwind plugin that filters saturated bg-* utilities under mode-light, (2) migrating all teacher CTAs to semantic class tokens (.btn-primary/.btn-warning/.btn-ghost) that already respect mode-light, or (3) a blanket rule like `html.mode-light.in-app [class*='bg-yellow-'], [class*='bg-teal-'], [class*='bg-emerald-'] { background:#111 !important; color:#fff !important; }` with narrow exceptions for the student-facing Kahoot answer colors (already excluded because student pages lack the .in-app class).

BubblesBackground still renders (bubbles visible in the light screenshots) — bubble color is gray but the animation may be a distraction on the 'tactile' surface; consider disabling the canvas entirely under mode-light for a cleaner, calmer neumorphic look.

settings audit surfaced buttons with bg rgba(17,17,17,0.10) and fg rgb(26,26,26). Visually fine (translucent overlay on light body) but WCAG contrast tools may flag them; consider bumping the inactive-pill bg opacity to 0.06 or fg to #111 for AA compliance.

The gradebook detail navigation: on /teacher/gradebooks the card doesn't expose a data-testid on 'فتح السجل' and the wrapper is neither <a> nor role=button consistently. Consider adding data-testid='gradebook-open-{id}' for future automation.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (5/6 audited pages clean; quiz editor has 2 colored buttons)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Light mode is enabled via localStorage.setItem('al_khairat_mode','light') then reload after login. The mode-light overrides only apply when html has BOTH 'mode-light' AND 'in-app' classes, which is why student page (/) is correctly unaffected. Screenshots saved under /app/.screenshots/light/. Only remaining colored elements in teacher light mode are the two buttons on /teacher/quiz/{id}/edit (bg-yellow-400 مراقبة الاختبار and bg-teal-600 نسخ). Dark mode default (localStorage 'dark' or unset) is untouched and verified. Dashboard's own 'مراقبة' badge is already monochromed via existing overrides; the issue is quiz editor specific.
rca of the issue: The Tactile OS light-theme overrides in index.css scope monochrome rules through .mode-light.in-app selectors targeting semantic classes and specific dashboard components. The QuizEditor page uses raw Tailwind color utilities (className='bg-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-500' and 'bg-teal-600 text-white') for the 'مراقبة الاختبار' and 'نسخ' buttons. Since no override rule targets these utility classes in the quiz editor context, they render with their default vibrant Tailwind colors and break the monochrome palette. Reproduction: login → localStorage al_khairat_mode=light → reload → open any quiz from dashboard via 'تعديل' → observe yellow badge top-left and teal 'نسخ' button next to the secret code. Fix: either replace with semantic tokens or add scoped overrides in the TACTILE OS section of /app/frontend/src/index.css.
